cap: Most high-grade serous carcinomas begin as serous tubal intraepithelial carcinoma at the fimbriated end of the fallopian tube, with an early TP53 mutation, and are the ovarian cancers of BRCA carriers. Shed cells seed the peritoneum and omentum, so women present late with bloating, early satiety and rising girth. Fewer ovulations lower the risk, and salpingectomy removes the tissue where the cancer starts.
